summary: Re-tested the fix for the iteration 49 HIGH bug (a lost reply caused duplicate sales and invoices) plus the smaller fixes. It is fixed. QUICK SALE: Playwright let the first POST /api/sales reach the server (201), then aborted the reply. The app showed the 'No signal' card and queued the sale under the SAME client_ref and made_at. OutboxSync resent it. The DB holds exactly 1 sale for that ref and stock went down once (20 -> 19). NEW INVOICE: the same test on POST /api/invoices (issued). Both POSTs carried the same client_ref, there is exactly 1 invoice (INV-1426), stock went down once (19 -> 18), and the app moved to /outbox, which showed 'Everything is sent'. Normal online cash sales: two in a row got two different refs and created two records (SL-536139, SL-536140), with the Synced card. Home outbox banner wording is correct in all cases: '1 invoice', '2 invoices', '1 sale', '2 sales', and 'sales and invoices' when mixed. Lock screen wrong PIN shows the toast 'Wrong PIN — try again' in the bad style (coral alert-circle). Sign-in with no network shows 'You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.'. Backend: 40/40 pass (test_iter49 16 + test_offline_send 3 + test_iter48 15 + new test_iter50_made_at_rules 6, all with -n 0). Confirmed: made_at is ignored without client_ref; staff (amina) can go 2 days back but 5 days falls back to now; owner can go 20 days back but 40 days falls back to now; the offline flag is False for a fresh ref and True when made_at is more than 2 minutes old.

minor.issue: Online quick sales now always send made_at from the phone clock, and the server accepts it (owner/manager 30 days back, staff 3 days, up to 5 minutes ahead). A phone whose clock is wrong will put normal online sales on the wrong date. A phone clock more than 2 minutes slow also marks online sales offline=True. Before this fix, online sales always used the server's now().
The docstring says 'Owners and admins' get 30 days, but the code gives 30 days to ('owner','manager'). A user record with no role defaults to 'owner' (the same convention as deps.py).

action_items: Optional: leave made_at out of the FIRST online POST /api/sales and send only client_ref. The server then uses its own time for a sale that lands at once, and the outbox can still send made_at when it retries. This stops a wrong phone clock from backdating online sales or wrongly flagging them offline. Alternatively, have the server ignore made_at when it is within a few minutes of now.
Fix the _made_at docstring so it matches the code (owner and manager get 30 days).
There is no DELETE /api/customers/{id}, so tests have no API way to clean up TEST customers. I removed mine by _id directly in Mongo.
critical_code_review_comments: quick-sale.tsx: attempt.current is reset only on success or offline. After a 4xx/5xx error the same ref is reused on the next tap. That is safe when the server inserted nothing. But if a 5xx happened after the insert and the user then changes the cart, the retry returns the OLD sale instead of the new cart. This is an edge case.

create_invoice: next_number() runs before insert_one. When two copies of the same ref race, the DuplicateKeyError path leaves a gap in invoice numbers (and in sale numbers for create_sale). This is minor.
The invoice outbox entry stores made_at but sendWaiting does not send it for invoices. That matches the design (invoices use issue_date).

rca_of_issue: Iteration 49 duplicate: fixed. The screens now create the ref (and made_at for sales) before the first POST and pass the same ref to keepOffline(). The server's _sent_before plus the unique partial index on (business_id, client_ref) return the existing record when the outbox resends.
